source: Fixture for issue 470: supervisor staleness only a subprocess test can observe from the architecture review of a real triage run on a 15-file Go package (#468). Co-change counts come from an analogous file pair in another repo: last 200 non-merge commits, commits of 30 files or fewer; shared 5 sits at K = 5 on purpose.

candidates.claim: Supervisor.Run exits through log.Fatalf, so a stale loop is observable only by re-running the test binary as a subprocess, and main repeats the prober's register-before-stall contract and its beat interval. Give Supervisor a pure Check(now) that returns the stale loops, an onStale callback, and a Go(name, interval, loop) that registers the loop before starting it and sets its stale limit from the interval, so neither main nor the prober states the contract.
candidates.removes: a subprocess test and a contract stated in two files

candidates.claim: Supervisor.Run's comment says main starts it after the metrics HTTP server; main starts no HTTP server.
